test_cases.name: bug_uses_issue_type_via_gh_api
test_cases.input: Create a bug issue in acme/web - the login page crashes when using SSO
assertions: Runs gh api repos/acme/web/issues -X POST with -f type="Bug"
Body follows the Bug Report template from references/templates.md (Description, Steps to Reproduce, Expected, Actual)
Does NOT use gh issue create, which has no --type flag
Does NOT add a [Bug] prefix to the title or a redundant bug label when the type is set

test_cases.name: quotes_array_params_for_zsh
test_cases.input: File a feature request for dark mode with the high-priority label and assign alice
assertions: Quotes the whole pair as 'labels[]=high-priority' and 'assignees[]=alice' in the gh api call

test_cases.name: asks_for_repo_when_missing
test_cases.input: Create an issue: export to CSV is broken
assertions: Confirms the target owner/repo before creating when the repo is not given and cannot be read from the current git remote
Does NOT run a create call against a guessed repository

test_cases.name: update_fetches_current_issue_first
test_cases.input: Close issue 42 and change its title to 'Login fails with SSO' in acme/web
assertions: Reads issue 42 first (mcp__github__issue_read or gh api GET) before the PATCH
Sends gh api repos/acme/web/issues/42 -X PATCH with only state and title
Reports the issue URL after the update

test_cases.name: dependencies_load_reference
test_cases.input: Mark issue 10 as blocked by issue 11 in acme/web
assertions: Reads references/dependencies.md before making the call
Uses the dependencies API from that reference, not a body edit or a label
Does NOT invent an endpoint that is not in the reference
